graphContract.color: SDR display-referred sRGB-encoded values; no linearization, gamma change or channel flip
graphContract.padding: input width/height even; no additional padding; output exactly twice input dimensions

runtime.purpose: ONNX Runtime Web build served to the ai-framegen-upscale browser harness. Only the three files listed are served (lib/serve.mjs); nothing is fetched from a CDN by the page.

build.executionProvider: native WebGPU EP (C++ onnxruntime/core/providers/webgpu compiled to WebAssembly with Dawn's emdawnwebgpu), not the JSEP build
build.evidence: dist/ort.webgpu.mjs selects ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.mjs (the jsep/jspi branches are compiled out: `false ? "ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.mjs" : ...`) and registers the WebGPU EP as "WebGPU" with device/deviceId/webgpuInstance/webgpuDevice options
